scope: Player search requests and streamed results, recruitment search and acceptance, and separate item-search requests sharing adjacent opcode integers.

method.native: Retained x86 instruction listings selected by exact RVA/function filename and matched function header, RVA header and first instruction VA, then authenticated instruction-by-instruction against the pinned PE using Python standard-library hashlib, re and struct. Each record hashes its complete authenticated instruction bytes in listing order. Direct PE jump-table, vtable and ASCII operand inspection. Published facts are summaries and VA locators, not copied decompilation bodies.
method.lua: Declared decoded-Lua archive authenticated against its corpus manifest, selected members against manifests/scripts.json, installed LPBs against manifests/retail_lua_coverage.json, and decoded Lua 5.1 code words inspected with a bounded chunk parser.

framing.record: Outbound builder record R has opcode u32 at R+0 and IPC byte length L at R+4. Application body A begins R+0x18.
framing.nativeCopy: FUN_00DAE010 at 0x00DAE0A9..0x00DAE0B8 copies L-0x10 bytes from R+0x18 to the IPC buffer+0x10.
framing.lengths: Application bytes = L-16. Capture subevent bytes = L+16, including the 16-byte subevent header and 16-byte IPC header. Native L must not be stored as a capture payloadLengths observation.
framing.integerEncoding: Little-endian except explicitly identified comment string lengths.

inboundDispatch.packetBasis: FUN_004CE190 reads the opcode from IPC+2 and passes IPC+0x10 as application pointer.
inboundDispatch.conclusion: The separate no-op ZoneProtoDown callbacks do not exclude application processing through FUN_004CE190. This route directly consumes search and recruitment packets; no alternative Lua receiver is needed to explain them. Order relative to the ZoneProtoDown callback invocation is not established.

recordEncoding.header: u8 result-row index; u16 big-endian text length N
recordEncoding.text: Text starts entry+3; byte entry+N+2 must be NUL. Cursor advances3+N, so N includes the terminator.
recordEncoding.target: Index must be below cached result-row count. The comment pointer is stored in native row+0x5C, outside its0x5C-byte wire prefix.
recordEncoding.continuation: Each packet copies600 bytes at the current cursor. Completed text remains before that cursor; the parser advances it only after complete records and resets the end word to that cursor at0x004C7A41. An unconsumed tail is overwritten by the next block; partial-record continuation is not established. It allocates a fresh0x1004-byte buffer when cursor+600 exceeds0x1000.
